Subject: RE: Project Kickoff - Web App Development

Hey team,

Just wanted to follow up on our conversation from earlier. So basically what we're looking for is a web application that can handle our customer data management. We need something that our sales team can use to track leads and manage client relationships.

The main features we discussed:
- User authentication (probably just email/password for now)
- Dashboard where users can see their assigned leads
- Lead management - add, edit, delete leads
- Basic reporting functionality
- Maybe some kind of notification system when leads are updated

We're expecting around 50 users initially, mostly our sales team and a few managers. The data isn't super sensitive but we do need basic security measures in place.

Budget wise we're thinking around $25k for the initial development, with potential for ongoing maintenance contracts.

Timeline is pretty flexible but we'd love to have something up and running within 3-4 months if possible.

Let me know if you need any more details or if there are other questions I should be thinking about.

Thanks!
